name: Sprout
description: A cute plant-watering reminder: your plants droop when they get thirsty and perk up after a drink, with daily reminders and a widget to water them in one tap — privately, offline, right on your iPhone.
about: Add your house plants once and Sprout keeps track of when each one needs water. Every plant has its own schedule, and you can see at a glance who is thirsty.
features: Each plant gets its own watering schedule, with care tips for popular houseplants
Plants droop when they get thirsty and perk up after a drink
A daily reminder when plants need water
Water a plant in one tap from the Home Screen widget
Pro: unlimited plants, fertilizer reminders on each plant's own schedule, a photo diary to see your plants grow and more pot colours
price: Free, with optional Pro as a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.
